evidence.name: Screen field: Open one section's settings
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Open one section's settings" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Open one section's settings
sections.description: Click the gear inside a section card to open that section's own settings. The first panel controls the section container — height, flex, scrollability, background, borders, alignment, padding, and margin — and the panel below controls the section's content, such as text, media, products, or button styling. This is the main place to tune how one block looks and behaves.
